description: Add page numbers to a PDF client and server side from freedailypro

format.description: The page-number format: plain (just the number), page-of-total, or prefixed.

pageRange.description: Comma-separated pages/ranges to number, e.g. '1,3-5' -- if omitted, numbers every page

position.description: Where to place it on the page. One of: bottom-center, bottom-right, bottom-left, top-center, top-right, top-left.

skipFirstPage.description: Whether to skip the first page.

startAt.description: The number to print on the first numbered page.

name: pdf_add_page_numbers
